paper_title: Constraints on axion-like particles with the Perseus Galaxy Cluster with MAGIC
notes: MAGIC 41.3 hr of NGC 1275 (Perseus cluster) VHE gamma-ray spectrum; photon-ALP mixing in the cluster B-field (spectral-irregularity search, not a DM search, so dm_density=null). Coupling convention is exactly canonical, Eq.(1.1): L = -(g_ag/4) F F~ a. Curve is the LOWER boundary of the 99% CL excluded region (solid black contour) traced from the raster Fig.2 (Sigma_plot.png), extracted by pixel-detecting the largest connected black component (solid contour; dashed 95% contour is broken into fragments) and taking the bottom edge (smallest excluded g) per mass column. Axes calibrated from major log-decade tick pixels: x 10^-9..10^-6 at px 204/371/538/705, y 10^-10/-11/-12 at px 153/358.5/564. Deepest point g=3.0e-12 GeV^-1 near m_a=46 neV, matching the paper's stated best sensitivity g_ag=3.0e-12 at m_a=40 neV; most competitive over 40-90 neV. Points at m>~4.5e-7 eV (g rising from ~5e-11 to ~5e-10) are the near-vertical right/closing edge of the excluded island where only large couplings are excluded. Paper explicitly states the exclusion region is shown at 99% CL (Fig.2/Fig.5). Excluded region is a closed 2D island; only its lower-right envelope (the limit) is reported.
